title: Acarajé
description: Acarajé is a dish from Brazil featuring black-eyed peas, yellow onion, garlic, shrimp. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Peanut-coconut topping stands in for vatapá paste; real acarajé also requires skinless ground black-eyed peas.

steps.instruction: Soak black-eyed peas, remove loose skins, drain very thoroughly and blend to a thick batter before shaping for palm-oil frying.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Deep-fry the previously shaped food in a suitably deep pan or fryer at about 170–175°C for 18 minutes, checking the center is cooked; drain on a rack.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
